scope: Definite English mistranslations found while reading full Chinese/English evidence for the houhanshu/038 identity review. Worker-authored; route to the active editorial application with a separate reviewer. Not part of the closed-schema identity reports.

repairs.before: On the return through Fengqiu the gate was too low for the imperial umbrella-carriage. The emperor flogged his carriage attendant; Yu Yan stepped forward and took the blame on himself as local postal inspector.
repairs.after: On the return through Fengqiu the gate was too low for the imperial umbrella-carriage. The emperor angrily ordered the attending censor flogged; Yu Yan stepped forward and took the blame on himself as local postal inspector.
repairs.zh: 還經封丘城門，門下小，不容羽蓋，帝怒，使撻侍禦史，延因下見引咎，以為罪在督郵。
repairs.reason: 使撻侍禦史: the emperor had the Attending Censor (侍御史) flogged; he did not flog a carriage attendant himself. The censor is the same official pardoned in s0171.

repairs.before: His honest plea moved the throne, which proclaimed: 'For Chenliu postal inspector Yu Yan's sake, spare the attendant.'
repairs.after: His honest plea moved the throne, which proclaimed: 'For Chenliu postal inspector Yu Yan's sake, pardon the censor.'
repairs.zh: 言辭激揚，有感帝意，乃制誥曰：『以陳留督郵虞延故，貰禦史罪。』
repairs.reason: 貰禦史罪 pardons the offence of the 御史 (the Attending Censor flogged in s0170); "attendant" misidentifies the official.

repairs.before: When Liu Ying of Chu's plot surfaced, a memorial named Jiao Kuang; Kuang was arrested but died on the road while fleeing illness, leaving wife and children shackled in the imperial jail for years of torture.
repairs.after: When Liu Ying of Chu's plot surfaced, a memorial named Jiao Kuang; Kuang was arrested but fell ill and died on the road, leaving wife and children shackled in the imperial jail for years of torture.
repairs.zh: 楚王英謀反發覺，以疏引貺，貺被收捕，疾病於道亡沒，妻子閉系詔獄，掠考連年。
repairs.reason: 疾病於道亡沒: Jiao Kuang fell gravely ill on the road and died; 亡沒 means died, and the source says nothing about fleeing.

repairs.before: King of Chu Ying's rebellion plot was discovered; by memorial Kuang was implicated; Kuang was seized and captured; ill on the road he died while fleeing; wife and children shut bound in edict prison; flog-examined successive years.
repairs.after: King of Chu Ying's rebellion plot was discovered; by memorial Kuang was implicated; Kuang was seized and captured; falling gravely ill on the road, he died; wife and children shut bound in edict prison; flog-examined successive years.
repairs.zh: 楚王英謀反發覺，以疏引貺，貺被收捕，疾病於道亡沒，妻子閉系詔獄，掠考連年。
repairs.reason: 疾病於道亡沒: 亡沒 is a binome meaning died; there is no flight in the source.

repairs.before: Zheng Hong argued that palace posts carried thin rewards, so few welcomed promotion under the old rule; he asked that gentlemen be posted as commandery-level magistrates and chief clerks as county elders.
repairs.after: Zheng Hong argued that palace posts carried thin rewards, so few welcomed promotion under the old rule; he asked that gentlemen be posted as magistrates of thousand-picul counties and chief clerks as county chiefs.
repairs.zh: 弘奏以為臺職雖尊，而酬賞甚薄，至於開選，多無樂者，請使郎補千石令，令史為長。
repairs.reason: 使郎補千石令，令史為長: gentlemen of the Secretariat to fill thousand-picul county magistracies (令) and Secretariat clerks to become county chiefs (長); these are county, not commandery, posts.

repairs.before: Hong memorialized holding that though terrace duties were honored, reward and emoluments were very thin; when it came to opening selection, many had no desire for it; he requested that gentlemen be assigned as magistrates of two thousand piculs and chief clerks as county elders.
repairs.after: Hong memorialized holding that though terrace duties were honored, reward and emoluments were very thin; when it came to opening selection, many had no desire for it; he requested that gentlemen be assigned as thousand-picul magistrates and chief clerks as county chiefs.
repairs.zh: 弘奏以為臺職雖尊，而酬賞甚薄，至於開選，多無樂者，請使郎補千石令，令史為長。
repairs.reason: 千石令 is a thousand-picul county magistrate, not two thousand piculs; 長 is the title county chief, not an elder.

repairs.before: Feng Fang drew grain from the treasury to win surrender; Yu Yan's grace sent prisoners home on time.
repairs.after: Feng Fang put the surrendered rebel band to use; Yu Yan's grace sent prisoners home on time.
repairs.reason: 魴用降帑: 帑 here stands for 孥 (followers/household). The eulogy recalls s0123-s0128, where Feng Fang pardoned Yan Bao's surrendered band and used them as his eyes and ears. No treasury grain is mentioned.

repairs.before: Fang used surrendering treasury; Yan moved returning prisoners.
repairs.after: Fang used the surrendered followers; Yan moved returning prisoners.
repairs.reason: 降帑 = 降孥, the surrendered followers (see s0123-s0128); "treasury" mistranslates the loan character.

repairs.before: Zheng Hong and the Dou clan were paired in strife; generation after generation turned hostile; Zhou Zhang defied the Way—petty wit, vaulting plot.
repairs.after: Zheng Hong and Dou Xian were paired in enmity, each in turn treating the other as foe; Zhou Zhang defied the Way—petty wit, vaulting plot.
repairs.zh: 鄭、竇怨偶，代相為仇，周章反道，小智大謀。
repairs.reason: 代相為仇: 代 means by turns (迭), not generations. The narrative (s0264-s0268) is a single feud between Zheng Hong and Dou Xian.

repairs.before: Zheng, Dou paired enmity; generation succeeding became foes; Zhou Zhang opposed the Way; small wisdom great plotting.
repairs.after: Zheng, Dou paired enmity; by turns became each other's foes; Zhou Zhang opposed the Way; small wisdom great plotting.
repairs.zh: 鄭、竇怨偶，代相為仇，周章反道，小智大謀。
repairs.reason: 代相為仇: 代 = 迭, alternately; the feud is between two contemporaries, not across generations.

repairs.before: Diwu Lun had been promoted to Minister of Works but ranked below Zheng Hong; at each New Year audience Hong bowed deeply and abased himself.
repairs.after: At that time Diwu Lun, the patron who had recommended Zheng Hong, was Minister of Works and ranked below him; at each New Year audience Hong bowed deeply and abased himself.
repairs.zh: 時舉將第五倫為司空，班次在下，每正朔朝見，弘曲躬而自卑。
repairs.reason: 時舉將第五倫為司空: 舉將 is the official who recommended Zheng Hong (Diwu Lun recommended him, s0207). The point of the passage is that Hong outranked his own patron; "promoted" loses this.

repairs.before: At that time the promoted general Diwu Lun was Minister of Works; his rank order was below Hong's; at each new-year audience Hong bowed deeply and abased himself.
repairs.after: At that time his recommending patron Diwu Lun was Minister of Works; his rank order was below Hong's; at each new-year audience Hong bowed deeply and abased himself.
repairs.zh: 時舉將第五倫為司空，班次在下，每正朔朝見，弘曲躬而自卑。
repairs.reason: 舉將 = the superior who recommended him (see s0207), not a "promoted general".

repairs.before: When Emperor Shang died, ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and hearts turned to him; fearing later resentment for not having enthroned him earlier, the empress dowager enthroned Liu You, son of King Xiao of Qinghe and brother of Emperor He—Emperor An.
repairs.after: When Emperor Shang died, ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and hearts turned to him; fearing later resentment for not having enthroned him earlier, the empress dowager enthroned Liu You, son of Emperor He's elder brother King Xiao of Qinghe—Emperor An.
repairs.zh: 及殤帝崩，群臣以勝疾非痼、意咸歸之，太后以前既不立，恐後為怨，乃立和帝兄清河孝王子祐，是為安帝。
repairs.reason: 和帝兄清河孝王子祐: King Xiao of Qinghe (Liu Qing) was Emperor He's elder brother; Liu You (Emperor An) was his son. The current English makes You the emperor's brother.

repairs.before: When Emperor Shang died, the host of ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and their hearts all turned to him; the empress dowager, because she had not enthroned him before, feared later resentment, and therefore enthroned You, son of King Xiao of Qinghe, brother of Emperor He—this was Emperor An.
repairs.after: When Emperor Shang died, the host of ministers held that Sheng's illness was not chronic and their hearts all turned to him; the empress dowager, because she had not enthroned him before, feared later resentment, and therefore enthroned You, son of Emperor He's elder brother King Xiao of Qinghe—this was Emperor An.
repairs.zh: 及殤帝崩，群臣以勝疾非痼、意咸歸之，太后以前既不立，恐後為怨，乃立和帝兄清河孝王子祐，是為安帝。
repairs.reason: 和帝兄 qualifies 清河孝王, not 祐; the current apposition misattributes the kinship.
